review_locator: PMCID:PMC6539149, Group 2 Innate Lymphoid Cells (ILC2): Type 2 Immunity and Helminth Immunity
primary_title: Group 2 innate lymphoid cells utilize the IRF4-IL-9 module to coordinate epithelial cell maintenance of lung homeostasis
decision_basis: The ILC2 review identifies the cited primary study as showing cooperative IL-33 and TSLP activation of lung ILC2s; the primary measures IL-5 in lung ILC2 culture supernatants after combined stimulation.
limitations_preserved: Measured IL-5 protein production after combined IL-33 and TSLP stimulation is supported in sorted mouse lung ILC2s; preserve the co-stimulation and lung ILC2 context and do not infer an unmeasured Il5 transcription-to-protein step, receptor stoichiometry, human equivalence, SCI transfer or terminal-TF mechanism.
